question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The children's laughter was filled with __exuberant__ joy
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"exuberant"** means full of energy, excitement, and cheerfulness. (उत्साही)

 
 
• **Example: **The garden was filled with exuberant flowers blooming in every color.
 
 
 
• **"Repressed"** means restrained, inhibited, or suppressed. (दबा हुआ)
 
 
• **Example: **His repressed emotions finally burst out when he couldn't hold back the tears anymore.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'exuberant'** is **'repressed'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Flawless **(निर्दोष): Without any imperfections or defects.

 
 
• **Example:** Her performance was flawless, earning her a standing ovation from the audience.
 
 
 
• **Euphoric **(आनंदित): Characterized by or feeling intense excitement and happiness.
 
 
• **Example: **Winning the championship left the team feeling euphoric.
 
 
 
• **Sarcastic** (व्यंग्यात्मक): Marked by or given to using irony in order to mock or convey contempt.
 
 
• **Example:** His sarcastic comments often hurt people's feelings.
